An '''unidentified being''' worked as an exporter for the [[Rim Commercial Mining]] corporation headed by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] [[Ja'Boag]]. This person was murdered by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].
